name: QuizVibe AI Public API
description: Nền tảng Gamification Quiz Tương Tác Thu Lead & Phân Phối Voucher với AI.

public.description: API discovery manifest and endpoint catalog.
Service health and operational status check.
Fetches sanitized public campaign data (questions without answers).
Fetches Top 10 public leaderboard entries with masked phone numbers.
Dynamic Open Graph HTML/metadata for social media crawlers.

player_session_required.description: Initialize a player quiz session for a published campaign. Issues a hash-only SHA-256 session token.
Submit an answer for the active question. Evaluated and scored server-side.
Finalize quiz session and compute authoritative final score.
Submit verified player contact details to unlock reward voucher.

admin_authenticated.description: Authenticate admin and issue HttpOnly session cookie.
Perform CRUD operations on campaigns, vouchers, and leads.

securityPolicies.antiCheat: Authoritative server-side answer evaluation. Question correct index is never sent to client.
securityPolicies.sessionIntegrity: Player session tokens are verified via SHA-256 hash. Plaintext tokens are never stored.
securityPolicies.privacy: Lead phone numbers are masked in public endpoints.
securityPolicies.rateLimiting: Submissions and session creation are protected against spam.
